say:2:1041308001:1.text: Don't you feel that the residents of Ivoryshade have some strange ideas about the outside world?
say:2:1041308001:1.source_cn: 诸位，你们有没有觉得月影乡的人对外面有一些……奇怪的认知？

say:3:1041308002:1.text: One family believed that the Wilders from the Dark Forest loved baked green beans and stuffed a bunch into my pocket.
say:3:1041308002:1.source_cn: 有一家人固执地认为来自薄暮丛林的绿裔都喜欢吃焗翠青豆，...

say:4:1041308003:1.text: Yes, I observed that also. Some older Wilders were convinced that I was from the Vaduso Mountains because they believed that the Wilders there all rode deer...
say:4:1041308003:1.source_cn: 的确如此。有几位老人始终认为我来自瓦度索山脉，因为他们...

say:5:1041308004:1.text: Don't they know that Ivoryshade is also located in the Vaduso Mountains?
say:5:1041308004:1.source_cn: ……他们应该知道，月影乡也位于瓦度索山脉吧？

say:6:1041308005:1.text: Who knows...? This is what humans mean by stereotypes.
say:6:1041308005:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢……这大概就是所谓的“刻板印象”吧……
